notes.title: The FPS Fixing Update
notes.notes:
Hello, guys! 

One of the biggest struggles of Explosive Candy World was getting the physics engine to run at the intended speed.

When I started developing this game, I had a monitor that only went up to 75FPS. So I programmed all of the game's speed without taking into account bigger framerates (too bad on my part haha). 

Soon after release, I bought a monitor that could go up to 144FPS, and was shocked to see that this game ran at lightning speed! It didn't run at the intended speed!

That was very frustrating, so I tried for some time to get this fixed, but with no success.

But now, it IS fixed! I applied a plugin that limits the game's FPS, so it can't go over 75FPS.

This is a little problematic for people who are used to high framerate monitors, but unfortunately that is the only solution possible.

Because right now everyone running the game at over 75FPS is getting an accelerated experience, like Sonic the Hedgehog, which is not the pace intended for Explosive Candy World.

Hopefully everyone enjoys this update and can experience the game again at the correct speed!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Our next game: Release Date Confirmed for the metroidvania Dimensional Animals!
notes.notes:
Release date SET!

Hello, guys! Marcos here. I'm the main developer behind Explosive Candy World.

I'm here to announce our next release: DIMENSIONAL ANIMALS!

This metroidvania adventure filled with action, exploration and retro goodness will release on June 5th, 2024!

We are just a few weeks away from its release. Hope you're excited!

The game will release at a fair price and I'll also bring in a very juicy release discount! So hopefully I can count on you to get your copy right as the game releases, on June 5th!

But I want to play NOW!

Don't worry, because while you wait for the full release of the game, I have launched an updated version of the demo allowing for a bit more of exploration!

You can download it now on Dimensional Animal's steam page.

Please also tell your friends about it and ask them to play the demo too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344060/Dimensional_Animals/

Thanks for hearing the news! I'm on full steam here to make the best experience possible!

See you soon!

Special thanks to all members of the Dimensional Animals development team:
- Hugo Andrade on pixel art
- Malu Colusso on music
- Jonas Siebeneichler on sound effects
